```{r}
#| output: asis
#| label: tbl-abr-infection-rate
#| tbl-cap: !expr 'sR$`tbl-abr-infection-rate`$`tbl-cap`'
#| tbl-cap-location: top

check_outlier_interpretation <- FALSE

# The version of the table the report renders, as for the infectious-agent
# table; see the marker of the same scope there.
# NEOIPC-COMPAT(infectious-agent-engine): remove the fallback once
# reports/compatibility.yml lists v0.0.0.9009 or later as tested and minimum
# together.
ia_slot <- if (identical(infectious_agent_rows, "ontology"))
  "abr_infection_rate_ontology_table" else "abr_infection_rate_table"
tbl_data <- benchmark_data[[ia_slot]]
if (is.null(tbl_data)) {
  ia_slot <- "abr_infection_rate_table"
  tbl_data <- benchmark_data[[ia_slot]]
}

# Conditionally render table only if department data exists
if (!is.null(tbl_data) &&
    "n_own" %in% rlang::names2(tbl_data) &&
    sum(tbl_data$n_own, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {

  ia_engine <- "node_id" %in% names(tbl_data)
  ia_groups <- identical(ia_slot, "abr_infection_rate_table")

  # Check if reference data columns exist
  has_reference <- "pooled_ref" %in% names(tbl_data) &&
    any(!is.na(tbl_data$pooled_ref))
  check_outlier_interpretation <- has_reference

  # A refused benchmark join still contributes all-NA `_ref` columns for the
  # table. Dropping them when there is no reference is what makes the table
  # show department rows only, as the not-comparable callout says it does.
  if (!has_reference)
    tbl_data <- tbl_data |> dplyr::select(!dplyr::ends_with("_ref"))

  cw <- compute_col_widths(tbl_data, stub_min = 27, has_reference = has_reference)

  # Row styling: the engine styles by `rank` and the row identity; the older
  # table styled by `taxon`. Within a block its Total heads the block, and a
  # summary row counts bacteria by Gram reaction or oxygen requirement.
  ia_node_id <- if (ia_engine) as.character(tbl_data$node_id) else character(0)
  ia_summary <- if (ia_engine)
    !is.na(ia_node_id) & grepl("^[a-z_]+\\|", ia_node_id) else
    rep(FALSE, nrow(tbl_data))
  ia_bold <- if (ia_engine) {
    (tbl_data$level == 0) | ia_summary |
      (ia_groups & !is.na(ia_node_id)) |
      (!ia_groups & !is.na(tbl_data$rank) & tbl_data$rank %in%
         c("Domain", "Kingdom", "Realm", "Subkingdom", "Phylum",
           "Order", "Genus", "Group"))
  } else {
    tbl_data$taxon %in% c("none", "domain", "kingdom", "order", "genus",
                          "coag_type")
  }
  ia_italic <- if (ia_engine) {
    !is.na(tbl_data$rank) & tbl_data$rank %in% c(
      "Realm", "Domain", "Subkingdom", "Kingdom", "Phylum", "Subphylum",
      "Class", "Subclass", "Order", "Suborder", "Family", "Subfamily",
      "Species", "Subspecies", "Serotype", "Variety")
  } else {
    tbl_data$taxon %in% c("domain", "kingdom", "order", "species")
  }

  ci_pattern <- ci_pattern_inline

  tbl <- tbl_data |>
    dplyr::select(-tidyselect::any_of(c(
      "n_ref", ".ontology_path_own", ".ontology_path_ref",
      "node_id", "parent_id", "rank",
      "quartile_departments_ref", "n_total_only_own", "n_total_only_ref",
      "total_own", "total_ref"))) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      group = dplyr::if_else(
        !ia_engine & stringr::str_detect(group, "spp."),
        paste0("*", stringr::str_extract(group, "^(.+) spp\\.(.*)$", 1), "* spp.", stringr::str_extract(group, "^(.+) spp\\.(.*)$", 2)),
        group
      )) |>
    dplyr::rename(
      !!sR$table_headers$count := "n_own",
      !!sR$table_headers$rate := "pooled_own",
      !!sR$table_headers$pooled := tidyselect::any_of("pooled_ref"),
      !!sR$table_headers$q1 := tidyselect::any_of("q1_ref"),
      !!sR$table_headers$q2 := tidyselect::any_of("q2_ref"),
      !!sR$table_headers$q3 := tidyselect::any_of("q3_ref"))

  ci_cols_to_drop <- character(0)
  if (!include_rate_ci)
    ci_cols_to_drop <- c(ci_cols_to_drop, "ci_lower_own", "ci_upper_own")
  if (!include_pooled_ci)
    ci_cols_to_drop <- c(ci_cols_to_drop, "ci_lower_ref", "ci_upper_ref")
  if (!include_quartile_ci)
    ci_cols_to_drop <- c(ci_cols_to_drop,
      "q1_ci_lower_ref", "q1_ci_upper_ref",
      "q2_ci_lower_ref", "q2_ci_upper_ref",
      "q3_ci_lower_ref", "q3_ci_upper_ref")
  if (length(ci_cols_to_drop) > 0)
    tbl <- tbl |> dplyr::select(-tidyselect::any_of(ci_cols_to_drop))

  tbl <- tbl |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      abr = dplyr::recode_values(
        .data$abr,
        "3gcr" ~ "3gcr",
        "car" ~ sR$carbr_label,
        "cor" ~ sR$colr_label,
        "mrsa" ~ sR$mrsa_label,
        "vre" ~ sR$vre_label),
      level = .data$level + if (ia_engine) 0L else 2L) |>
    dplyr::group_by(.data$abr) |>
    gt(rowname_col = "group") |>
    sub_missing() |>
    gt::tab_options(
      latex.header_repeat = TRUE,
      latex.use_longtable = TRUE,
      table.width = pct(100),
      table.font.size = cw$font_size,
      footnotes.marks = "extended"
    ) |>
    fmt_number(
      columns = !(tidyselect::any_of(sR$table_headers$count) | tidyselect::matches("^(group|level|taxon|abr)$")),
      decimals = 1,
      sep_mark = sR$digit_group_separator,
      min_sep_threshold = 2,
      locale = locale_gt) |>
    fmt_integer(
      columns = sR$table_headers$count,
      sep_mark = sR$digit_group_separator,
      min_sep_threshold = 2) |>
    gt::fmt_markdown(
      columns = "group"
    ) |>
    gt::tab_stub_indent(
      rows = gt::everything(),
      indent = gt::from_column(column = "level")
    ) |>
    tab_row_group(
      label = gt::md(sR$`3gcr_label`),
      rows = abr == "3gcr"
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(
        weight = "bold"
      ),
      locations = cells_row_groups()
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(
        weight = "bold"
      ),
      locations = cells_stub(
        rows = ia_bold
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(
        style = "italic"
      ),
      locations = cells_stub(
        rows = ia_italic
      )
    ) |>
    cols_hide(columns = any_of(c("level","taxon"))) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
      locations = list(
        cells_column_spanners(),
        cells_column_labels(),
        cells_row_groups()
      )
    ) |>
      tab_spanner(
        label = if (ia_engine) sR$`tbl-abr-infection-rate`$rate_name_engine else
          sR$`tbl-abr-infection-rate`$`rate_name`,
        columns = tidyselect::any_of(
          c(
            sR$table_headers$rate,
            sR$table_headers$pooled,
            sR$table_headers$q1,
            sR$table_headers$q2,
            sR$table_headers$q3)),
        id = "resistant_pathogen_infection_rate",
        level = 2
      ) |>
    tab_footnote(
      footnote = md(
        paste0(
          "$$\\text{",
          if (ia_engine) sR$`tbl-abr-infection-rate`$rate_name_engine else
            sR$`tbl-abr-infection-rate`$`rate_name`,
          "} = \\frac{\\text{",
          if (ia_engine) sR$`tbl-abr-infection-rate`$rate_numerator_engine else
            sR$`tbl-abr-infection-rate`$`rate_numerator`,
          "}}{\\text{",
          if (ia_engine) sR$`tbl-abr-infection-rate`$rate_denominator_engine else
            sR$`tbl-abr-infection-rate`$`rate_denominator`,
          "}} \\times ",
          format_integer(if (ia_engine) 1000 else 100),
          "$$"
        )),
      locations = cells_column_spanners(spanners = "resistant_pathogen_infection_rate"),
      placement = "right"
    ) |>
    tab_footnote(
      footnote = interpolate_translation(
        if (ia_engine) sR$`tbl-abr-infection-rate`$n_footnote_engine else
          sR$`tbl-abr-infection-rate`$n_footnote,
        column = sR$table_headers$count),
      locations = cells_column_labels(columns = sR$table_headers$count),
      placement = "right"
    ) |>
    tab_footnote(
      footnote = interpolate_translation(
        if (ia_engine) sR$`tbl-abr-infection-rate`$rate_footnote_engine else
          sR$`tbl-abr-infection-rate`$rate_footnote,
        column = sR$table_headers$rate),
      locations = cells_column_labels(columns = sR$table_headers$rate),
      placement = "right"
    )

  if (include_rate_ci && "ci_lower_own" %in% colnames(tbl$`_data`)) {
    tbl <- tbl |>
      gt::cols_merge(
        columns = c(sR$table_headers$rate, "ci_lower_own", "ci_upper_own"),
        pattern = ci_pattern,
        rows = !is.na(tbl_data$pooled_own)
      )
  }
  if (include_pooled_ci && "ci_lower_ref" %in% colnames(tbl$`_data`)) {
    tbl <- tbl |>
      gt::cols_merge(
        columns = c(sR$table_headers$pooled, "ci_lower_ref", "ci_upper_ref"),
        pattern = ci_pattern,
        rows = !is.na(tbl_data$pooled_ref)
      )
  }
  if ("q1_ci_lower_ref" %in% colnames(tbl$`_data`)) {
    if (include_quartile_ci) {
      has_boot <- !is.na(tbl$`_data`[["q1_ci_lower_ref"]])
      tbl <- tbl |>
        gt::cols_merge(
          columns = c(sR$table_headers$q1, "q1_ci_lower_ref", "q1_ci_upper_ref"),
          pattern = ci_pattern,
          rows = has_boot
        ) |>
        gt::cols_merge(
          columns = c(sR$table_headers$q2, "q2_ci_lower_ref", "q2_ci_upper_ref"),
          pattern = ci_pattern,
          rows = has_boot
        ) |>
        gt::cols_merge(
          columns = c(sR$table_headers$q3, "q3_ci_lower_ref", "q3_ci_upper_ref"),
          pattern = ci_pattern,
          rows = has_boot
        )
    } else {
      tbl <- tbl |> gt::cols_hide(columns = tidyselect::any_of(c(
        "q1_ci_lower_ref", "q1_ci_upper_ref",
        "q2_ci_lower_ref", "q2_ci_upper_ref",
        "q3_ci_lower_ref", "q3_ci_upper_ref")))
    }
  }

  if (has_reference) {
    tbl <- tbl |>
      cols_width(
        stub() ~ pct(cw$stub),
        sR$table_headers$count ~ pct(cw$n),
        sR$table_headers$rate ~ pct(cw$rate),
        sR$table_headers$pooled ~ pct(cw$pooled),
        sR$table_headers$q1 ~ pct(cw$q),
        sR$table_headers$q2 ~ pct(cw$q),
        sR$table_headers$q3 ~ pct(cw$q)
      ) |>
      tab_spanner(
        label = sR$own_data_label,
        columns = tidyselect::any_of(c(sR$table_headers$count, sR$table_headers$rate)),
        id = "department_data"
      ) |>
      tab_spanner(
        label = sR$reference_data,
        columns = c(
          sR$table_headers$pooled,
          sR$table_headers$q1,
          sR$table_headers$q2,
          sR$table_headers$q3),
        id = "reference_data"
      ) |>
      tab_footnote(
        footnote = interpolate_translation(
          sR$`tbl-abr-infection-rate`$pooled_footnote,
          column = sR$table_headers$pooled),
        locations = cells_column_labels(columns = sR$table_headers$pooled),
        placement = "right")
  } else {
    tbl <- tbl |>
      cols_width(
        stub() ~ pct(cw$stub),
        sR$table_headers$count ~ pct(cw$n),
        sR$table_headers$rate ~ pct(cw$rate)
      )
  }

  if (any(!is.na(tbl_data$pooled_own) & tbl_data$n_own < sparse_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)) {
    sparse_note <- interpolate_translation(if (include_rate_ci) sR$sparse_data_footnote else sR$sparse_data_footnote_no_ci, threshold = sparse_threshold)
    tbl <- tbl |>
      gt::tab_footnote(
        footnote = sparse_note,
        locations = cells_body(
          columns = sR$table_headers$count,
          rows = !is.na(tbl_data$pooled_own) & tbl_data$n_own < sparse_threshold),
        placement = "right")
  }

  # Total row deduplication footnote
  tbl <- tbl |>
    gt::tab_footnote(
      footnote = sR$`tbl-abr-infection-rate`$total_dedup_footnote,
      locations = gt::cells_stub(
        rows = tbl_data$group == "Total"),
      placement = "right")

  # Infections a block's Total counts but no row of the block counts: the
  # engine reports that number on each block's Total.
  if (ia_engine) {
    ia_total_only <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(tbl_data$n_total_only_own))
    for (ia_row_i in seq_along(ia_total_only)) {
      if (!is.na(ia_total_only[ia_row_i]) && ia_total_only[ia_row_i] > 0)
        tbl <- tbl |>
          gt::tab_footnote(
            footnote = interpolate_translation(
              sR$`tbl-abr-infection-rate`$block_total_only_footnote,
              count = format_integer(ia_total_only[ia_row_i])),
            locations = gt::cells_body(
              columns = sR$table_headers$count,
              rows = ia_row_i),
            placement = "right")
    }
  }

  # Resistance category overlap source note
  tbl <- tbl |>
    gt::tab_source_note(
      source_note = sR$`tbl-abr-infection-rate`$resistance_overlap_footnote)

  # The summary block counts the same infections as the groups, apart from
  # them; it is a property of the engine's groups version.
  if (ia_engine && ia_groups && any(ia_summary, na.rm = TRUE))
    tbl <- tbl |>
      gt::tab_source_note(source_note = sR$summary_block_note)

  # n.o.s. definition source note
  ia_residual <- if (ia_engine)
    !is.na(ia_node_id) & grepl("~n\\.o\\.s\\.$", ia_node_id) else
    tbl_data$taxon == "species_nos"
  if (any(ia_residual, na.rm = TRUE)) {
    tbl <- tbl |>
      gt::tab_source_note(source_note = sR$nos_footnote)
    if (ia_engine && any(ia_above_genus(tbl_data, ia_node_id, ia_residual),
                         na.rm = TRUE))
      tbl <- tbl |>
        gt::tab_source_note(
          source_note = sR$residual_above_genus_footnote)
  }

  tbl
} else {
  no_data_table()
}
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
# Show explanation when no resistant pathogens were detected
if (is.null(tbl_data) ||
    !("n_own" %in% rlang::names2(tbl_data)) ||
    sum(tbl_data$n_own, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
  note <- sR$`tbl-abr-infection-rate`$no_resistant_pathogens_note
  ast_enabled <- params$includeAntibioticResistanceTestRateTable
  if (ast_enabled && !is.null(sR$`tbl-abr-infection-rate`$no_resistant_pathogens_note_ast_ref))
    note <- paste(note, sR$`tbl-abr-infection-rate`$no_resistant_pathogens_note_ast_ref)
  cat("\n\n::: {.callout-note}\n")
  cat(note, "\n")
  cat(":::\n")
}
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
if (check_outlier_interpretation) {
  states <- metric_registry[[ia_slot]]
  if (has_outliers(states)) {
    grouped <- group_outliers(states, ia_slot, sR,
                              metric_registry,
                              labels = metric_labels[[ia_slot]])
    outlier_text <- format_outlier_text(grouped, sR)
    if (nchar(outlier_text) > 0) {
      cat("\n\n::: {.callout-tip}\n")
      cat("## ", sR$outlier$heading, "\n\n")
      cat(outlier_text, "\n")
      cat(":::\n")
    }
  }
}
```
